title: API Authentication Failure: Persistent Token Generation Error
body:
**Bug Description**
I am trying to use claude, but it keeps saying: API Error, I reinstalled, logout/login, and same error. no tokens are generated, and it from time to time even not using it says that Opus 4 has reached its limit.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: linux
- Terminal: vte-based
- Version: 1.0.25
- Feedback ID: cad898ea-fea3-4ee6-91ee-f0b47950950a

**Errors**
```json
[{"error":"RangeError [ERR_CHILD_PROCESS_STDIO_MAXBUFFER]: stdout maxBuffer length exceeded\n    at Socket.onChildStdout (node:child_process:481:14)\n    at Socket.emit (node:events:518:28)\n    at Socket.emit (node:domain:489:12)\n    at addChunk (node:internal/streams/readable:561:12)\n    at readableAddChunkPushByteMode (node:internal/streams/readable:512:3)\n    at Readable.push (node:internal/streams/readable:392:5)\n    at Pipe.onStreamRead (node:internal/stream_base_commons:189:23)","timestamp":"2025-06-17T20:54:08.743Z"}]
```
